description: This header file declares the class AdbLegacyEndpointObject, which encapsulates a handle to a USB endpoint managed by a legacy Android USB driver. It defines methods for creating, managing, and performing asynchronous and synchronous read/write operations on the endpoint, and includes details about the class's inheritance and members.

classes.name: AdbLegacyEndpointObject
classes.description: A class that manages a handle to a legacy USB endpoint, providing mechanisms for asynchronous and synchronous I/O operations in the context of Android's USB handling infrastructure.

methods.name: AdbLegacyEndpointObject
methods.description: Constructor initializing the endpoint object with its parent interface, endpoint ID, and index.

methods.name: ~AdbLegacyEndpointObject
methods.description: Destructor, intentionally protected to prevent stack allocation.

methods.name: CommonAsyncReadWrite
methods.description: Performs asynchronous read/write operations with support for overlapped I/O and event signaling.

methods.name: CommonSyncReadWrite
methods.description: Performs synchronous read/write operations with optional timeout.

methods.name: CreateHandle
methods.description: Creates and opens a handle to the USB endpoint given a device path and access/sharing modes.

methods.name: CloseHandle
methods.description: Closes the open handle to the endpoint.

methods.name: HANDLE usb_handle() const
methods.description: Accessor for retrieving the handle to the USB endpoint.
